description: THE COIL LIVE FEED: the engine-grade board Coil's live record trades from, a superset of the complete live board that adds per-name structural stop and target levels, stop/target basis, risk-reward, buy_score, conviction, lane, leveraged vehicle and ladder placement (engine_fields, including coil_score / coil_kind). Optional symbols[] filter. Size, measured on ~800 names: unfiltered ≈1.35 MB (hundreds of thousands of tokens); a 2-name symbols read ≈70 KB; the same read with compact=true ≈12 KB; compact=true for the whole board ≈350 KB. Optional fields[] picks engine fields; limit and cursor page the names by symbol. Refreshed about every 5 minutes in market hours; identical for every subscriber; research, not advice. Engine fields are self-described in the payload's `schema` block (key · tier · description · since; omitted when compact=true). Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data.

compact.description: Optional, default false (the full payload, unchanged). true = core fields only: names[] and engine_fields[] keep the core keys, and the fixed context blocks (schema, rotation, awareness, perf, pair_rotation, books beyond regime, day rows/cohorts) are dropped. candidates[], freshness and rules_version always ride.

cursor.description: Optional: the page.next_cursor from the previous page (the last symbol returned). Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Optional: keep only these engine_fields keys per name (e.g. ["stop","target","rr"]). Unknown keys are echoed in unknown_fields. With compact=true this replaces the core engine-field set.

limit.description: Optional: page size, names per page (sorted by symbol). The response carries page.next_cursor.

symbols.description: Optional: trim names + engine_fields to these tickers (max 50)

name: get_engine_feed
